title: Creator Pack / Narrative Inspector & Dependency Graph
objective: Resume the interrupted CNI family after the completed MAS interstitial by providing deterministic developer/creator inspection surfaces for manifests, component selection, dependency graphs, condition explanations, scoped state references, dialogue/trigger links, localization coverage, patch conflicts and provenance without becoming public sharing, marketplace or canonical owner-state authority.

scope.purpose: Provide creator/developer inspection and debugging projections over the completed CNI-01..11 content/narrative interoperability foundations without creating a second content runtime, canonical state store, sharing system or marketplace.
scope.completion_gate: A representative creator/developer inspection workspace can deterministically explain and traverse explicit CNI manifest/component/dependency/condition/state/dialogue/trigger/localization/conflict/provenance references, fails closed on invalid or unauthorized references, preserves visibility and owner-domain boundaries, and does not mutate canonical state or imply public sharing/marketplace authority.

selection_boundaries: CNI-01 through CNI-11 and MAS-01 through MAS-21 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.
Validation Core deliberately transitioned from MAS back to CNI at governed start, sealing MAS-21 as predecessor baseline and retiring MAS automatic validation authority without historical MAS reruns.

CNI-12 remained an authoring/debugging projection only and created no second content runtime, canonical state store, sharing/distribution system, marketplace, rights registry, provenance authority or owner-domain mutation path.
A9 visibility projection retained authorization-before-projection semantics; unauthorized linked node/edge identities and hidden cardinality are not exposed.
CNI-02 dependency truth remained pack-level and CNI-10 retained localization/fallback authority; CNI-12 consumed those semantics rather than inventing replacements.
Manual full-patch review identified and corrected dependency-topology overreach, linked-reference visibility leakage and localization-rule duplication before final terminal validation.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after CNI-12; no newly unlocked cross-program rotation supersedes CNI-13, so CNI strict order selects CNI-13.
PCA remains eligible where its own current DAG gates are satisfied but remains unselected; CNI-13, PCA-01, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work were not implemented by this tranche.

review_findings: pack-level dependency topology must not be projected as invented component-level edges
linked unauthorized state/predicate/overlay identities must be filtered from inspection sections
localization coverage must consume CNI-10 projection semantics rather than reimplement fallback rules

next_action: CNI-12 is closed. CNI-13 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
